articles.title: Director James Cameron finally addresses Amy Poehler’s 'ignorant' joke about his marriage

Cameron's delayed response brings an old celebrity interaction back into public discourse, illustrating ongoing dynamics within the entertainment industry.

articles.title: AgustaWestland ‘scam’: Court rejects plea to release Michel James, but modifies his bail conditions
articles.summary: A Delhi court rejected Christian Michel James' plea for release in the AgustaWestland VVIP chopper scam's corruption case. Michel, an alleged middleman, sought relief, but the court denied it. This decision pertains to a high-profile case involving alleged corruption in the procurement of VVIP helicopters, a matter of significant national importance and defence integrity.
